Original (unmodified) input datasets from ggaction/chart-datasets, commit
0333f33f043f0f18fb1b317333bd7cef61fb39a1, charts/<id>/data.json.
These fixtures cover one-column distributions (vl_0043), category counts
(vl_0012), supplied confidence bounds (vl_0024), Likert labels and singleton
subgroups (vl_0013), and calendar aggregation (vl_0096).
Final-cell appearance and compound/text semantics additionally use Tips
(vl_1486) and Iris (vl_1278), from that same corpus snapshot.
